extraction_text: The Company retains the exclusive right to manage the business and the plants and to direct the working force, subject, however, to the specific provisions of this Agreement. The right to manage the business and plants and to direct the working force includes, but is not limited to, the right to hire, assign work to employees, suspend or discharge employees for just cause, and to relieve employees from duty because of lack of work or for other legitimate reasons, to introduce new and improved methods or facilities, to change existing methods or facilities, to make and enforce reasonable rules and regulations, to determine the processes and extent of the business or production, the types and quantities of machinery, equipment and materials to be used, the nature, extent, duration, character and method of operation, the quality and quantity of workmanship and work required.

The Company agrees to notify the Union within ten (10) days after introducing a new job classification and/or new equipment to discuss a wage rate. The wage rate agreed upon shall be retroactive to the first day of use and shall be paid to the employee(s) that were so assigned. If the Union and Company cannot agree on the above within fifteen (15) days, the Company shall have the right to set the wage rate and the Union may refer the matter no later than thirty (30) days to arbitration pursuant to Article I, Section 5 of this Agreement.
